title: Climate-induced migration or immobility? Evidence from Nigeria
title_primary: Climate-induced migration or immobility? Evidence from Nigeria
authors: Marco Letta, Pierluigi Montalbano, Adriana Paolantonio
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The complex relationship between climate shocks, adaptation, and migration hinders a rigorous understanding of the heterogeneous mobility outcomes of farm households exposed to climate stress. To unpack this heterogeneity, we couple causal machine learning methods, tailored to a conceptual framework bridging economic migration theory and the poverty traps literature, with longitudinal multi-topic household data from Nigeria. This approach allows us to produce fine-grained, non-parametric evidence that identifies the factors driving divergent mobility outcomes across different household groups affected by the same shocks. The estimated conditional average treatment effects suggest that key variables—pre-shock asset levels, in situ adaptive capacity, and weather exposure during the previous survey period—shape not only the magnitude but also the sign of the impact of agriculture-relevant weather anomalies on the mobility outcomes of farming households. While in situ adaptation serves as an alternative to migration, the role played by wealth constraints and multiple shock exposure is consistent with the existence of climate-induced immobility traps.

title: Canaries in the Gold Mine: Early Productivity Gains from Artificial Intelligence Creating Organization Capital
title_zh: 金矿中的金丝雀：人工智能创造组织资本的早期生产率提升

authors: Tania Babina, Alex He, Renhao Jiang

abstract: Using a new firm-level measure of AI investment based on AI-skilled employment---spanning machine learning through generative and agentic AI---we show that AI investments are associated with productivity growth in recent years, but not over the previous decade. We trace the productivity gains to the accumulation of organization capital that AI helps create: durable firm-specific knowledge acquired through learning-by-doing that enables more efficient production. We build a novel measure of organization capital based on workers' job descriptions and document that productivity gains are driven by AI-skilled jobs that build organization capital. Overall, our findings suggest that AI investment generates productivity growth by creating organization capital.
abstract_zh: 利用一项基于AI技能就业的新型企业层面AI投资衡量指标——涵盖从机器学习到生成式与代理式AI——我们表明，近年来AI投资与生产率增长相关联，但在过去十年中则不然。我们将生产率收益追溯至AI助力积累的组织资本：通过干中学获得的持久企业特定知识，这些知识能够实现更高效的生产。我们基于员工职位描述构建了一种新颖的组织资本衡量方法，并记录到生产率提升主要由构建组织资本的AI技能岗位所驱动。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，AI投资通过创造组织资本来促进生产率增长。

authors: Adrian Bruhin, Simon Haenni, Lingqing Jiang, Adrian Roethlisberger, Regula Buchli 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: If individuals’ prosocial motivations are complements, this creates an important lever for the provision of social capital. We develop a framework to identify motivation complementarities and apply it in the context of voluntary blood donations—a key example of a purely prosocial behavior. Using quasi-random phone calls to identify causal effects, we find that a 10 percentage point increase in the donation rate for a blood drive raises a focal donor’s turnout by about 5.6 percentage points, creating a policy multiplier of 2.3. We also rule out lower costs from joint traveling as the main driver of the motivation complementarities. Rather, they result, at least partly, from more general mechanisms, such as utility from social approval, peer pressure, or social image concerns.
abstract_zh: 如果个体的亲社会动机具有互补性，这将为社会资本的供给提供一个重要的杠杆。我们构建了一个框架来识别动机互补性，并将其应用于自愿献血情境——这是纯粹亲社会行为的一个关键例子。利用准随机电话呼叫来识别因果效应，我们发现，献血活动中献血率每提高10个百分点，会使焦点捐赠者的参与率上升约5.6个百分点，从而产生2.3的政策乘数效应。我们还排除了共同出行降低成本作为动机互补性主要驱动因素的可能性。相反，这些互补性至少部分源于更普遍的机制，如社会认可带来的效用、同伴压力或社会形象关注。

title: The comparative statics of dominance
title_zh: 支配地位的比较静态分析
title_primary: 支配地位的比较静态分析
title_secondary: The comparative statics of dominance
authors: Ludvig Sinander, Mark Whitmeyer, Gregorio Curello
official: 官方在线 2026-08-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In finite problems comprising objects, cases, and an object- and case-contingent payoff function, we study the comparative statics of the set of undominated objects, meaning those for which there exists no mixture over objects that is superior in every case. We consider both weak and strict dominance (corresponding to different degrees of ‘strictness’ in the definition of superiority). Our main theorem characterises those payoff transformations which robustly expand the not-weakly-dominated and not-strictly-dominated sets: the necessary and sufficient condition is that payoffs be transformed separately across cases, in either a monotone–concave or a constant manner. We apply our results to Pareto frontiers and games.
abstract_zh: 在由对象、情形及依赖于对象与情形的收益函数构成的有限问题中，我们研究了无支配对象集合的比较静态性质，即那些不存在任何在每种情形下均更优的对象混合的对象。我们同时考虑了弱支配与严格支配（对应于“更优”定义中不同程度的“严格性”）。我们的主要定理刻画了那些能够稳健地扩展非弱支配集合与非严格支配集合的收益变换：其必要且充分条件是，收益需按情形分别进行变换，且变换方式要么是单调凹的，要么是恒定的。我们将结果应用于帕累托前沿与博弈中。

title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Wealth Inequalities in Great Britain
title_zh: 非常规货币政策与英国财富不平等
title_primary: 非常规货币政策与英国财富不平等
title_secondary: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Wealth Inequalities in Great Britain
authors: Anastasios Evgenidis, Apostolos Fasianos, Tobias Adrian, Marcin Kolasa, Christopher Erceg 等
official: 官方在线 2020-04-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores whether unconventional monetary policy operations have redistributive effects on household wealth. Drawing on household balance sheet data from the Wealth and Asset Survey, we construct monthly time series indicators on the distribution of different asset types held by British households for the period that the monetary policy switched, as the policy rate reached the zero-lower bound. Using this series, we estimate the response of wealth inequalities on monetary policy, taking into account the effect of unconventional policies conducted by the Bank of England in response to the Global Financial Crisis. Our evidence reveals that unconventional monetary policy shocks have significant and lingering effects on wealth inequality: the shock raises wealth inequality across households, as measured by their Gini coefficients, percentile shares, and other standard inequality indicators. Additionally, we explore the effects of different transmission channels simultaneously. We find that the portfolio rebalancing channel and house price effects widen the wealth gap, outweighing the counterbalancing impact of the savings redistribution and inflation channels. The findings of our analysis help to raise awareness of central bankers about the redistributive effects of their monetary policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了非常规货币政策操作是否对家庭财富产生再分配效应。利用财富与资产调查中的家庭资产负债表数据，我们构建了英国家庭持有不同类型资产分布的月度时间序列指标，覆盖货币政策转向且政策利率触及零下限的时期。基于该序列，我们估算了财富不平等对货币政策的响应，并纳入了英格兰银行应对全球金融危机所实施的非常规政策的影响。证据表明，非常规货币政策冲击对财富不平等具有显著且持久的影响：该冲击加剧了家庭间的财富不平等，这一结论通过基尼系数、百分位份额及其他标准不平等指标得以衡量。此外，我们同时探讨了不同传导渠道的作用。研究发现，投资组合再平衡渠道和房价效应扩大了财富差距，其影响超过了储蓄再分配渠道和通胀渠道的抵消作用。本研究的发现有助于提高央行官员对其货币政策决策再分配效应的认识。

title: On the dynamics of coordinated hierarchies: Economic growth versus poverty traps
title_zh: 协调层级动态研究：经济增长与贫困陷阱
title_primary: 协调层级动态研究：经济增长与贫困陷阱
title_secondary: On the dynamics of coordinated hierarchies: Economic growth versus poverty traps
authors: Elena A. Gubar, Livia Owen, Edgar J. Sanchez Carrera, Tatyana V. Gerschuk
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study development traps generated by payoff-mediated coordination between an institutional layer and a private-sector layer. The leading interpretation is the transition from informality to formal-sector participation: institutional effort raises the return to formalisation, while formal participation raises the fiscal, compliance, and legitimacy returns to institutional effort. The paper develops this mechanism through nested continuous-time replicator models. The one-population benchmark gives the familiar critical-mass and hysteresis result. The two-role follower model shows how a scalar threshold becomes a stable saddle branch. The main contribution is a leader–follower phase-plane analysis: we derive local stability conditions for joint poverty, joint prosperity, and decoupled regimes; give sufficient global conditions under which the stable manifold of an interior saddle is the basin boundary; and prove a comparison result showing that payoff-improving reforms weakly expand the basin of joint prosperity. A multi-role extension records local rare-deviation stability and monotone nullcline shifts, without claiming a complete global classification in four dimensions. The analysis implies that unilateral policy interventions do not fail by definition; they fail when the induced state remains in the basin of the low-activity equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 我们研究由制度层与私营部门层之间通过收益中介的协调所产生的“发展陷阱”。主导性解释是从非正规经济向正规部门参与的转型：制度努力提高了正规化的回报，而正规参与则提升了制度努力在财政、合规及合法性方面的回报。本文通过嵌套的连续时间复制者模型来阐述这一机制。单群体基准模型给出了熟悉的临界规模与滞后效应结果。双角色追随者模型展示了标量阈值如何演变为稳定的鞍分支。主要贡献在于领导者-追随者相平面分析：我们推导了共同贫困、共同繁荣及分离状态下的局部稳定性条件；给出了内部鞍点的稳定流形作为盆地边界的充分全局条件；并证明了一个比较结果，即收益改善型改革会弱扩展共同繁荣的盆地。多角色扩展记录了局部稀有偏差稳定性及单调零斜线移动，但未声称在四维空间中提供完整的全局分类。分析表明，单边政策干预并非必然失败；它们仅在所诱导的状态仍停留在低活动均衡的盆地内时才会失败。

title: AI and Economic Divergence in Asia
title_zh: 人工智能与亚洲经济分化
title_primary: 人工智能与亚洲经济分化
title_secondary: AI and Economic Divergence in Asia
authors: Ms. Natasha X Che & Weining Xin & Taichi Yoshida
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using a small open economy overlapping generations model, this paper examines how AI can drive economic divergence across and within Asian economies. While AI adoption may promise sizable productivity gains, it could create temporary but potentially longlasting divergence across countries. Structurally-prepared advanced economies tend to adopt AI earlier and see immediate growth gains while emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) face delayed adoption and initial growth headwinds from rising costs of capital. Structural reforms that boost productivity and strengthen human capital not only accelerate adoption in EMDEs but also amplify the growth gains. Within countries, AI adoption could widen inequality along multiple dimensions: across skill groups, as high-skilled workers benefit disproportionately from complementarity with the more capital-intensive technology, and across generation, as the shift of national income toward capital favors asset-rich older households relative to younger workers who rely primarily on labor income. Redistributive policies can help mitigate these distributional pressures, though they entail equity efficiency trade-offs that vary with country-specific fiscal and demographic conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文运用小型开放经济重叠世代模型，探讨人工智能如何驱动亚洲各经济体之间及其内部的经济分化。尽管采用人工智能可能带来可观的生产率提升，却也可能引发各国间暂时但可能持久的分化。结构性准备充分的发达经济体往往较早采用人工智能，并立即获得增长收益，而新兴市场和发展中经济体则面临采用延迟及资本成本上升带来的初期增长阻力。提升生产率并强化人力资本的结构性改革，不仅能加速新兴市场和发展中经济体的技术采用，还能放大增长收益。在国家内部，人工智能的采用可能从多个维度加剧不平等：在技能群体之间，高技能劳动者因与资本密集型技术的互补性而获益不成比例；在代际之间，国民收入向资本倾斜，有利于资产丰厚的老年家庭，而不利于主要依赖劳动收入的年轻劳动者。再分配政策有助于缓解这些分配压力，但需权衡公平与效率，其取舍因各国财政与人口状况而异。

title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt

title_primary: 双边主权债务的风险
title_secondary: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
authors: Francisco Roldan, César Sosa-Padilla
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Motivated by the emergence of new official creditors outside the Paris Club framework, we study the interaction between senior official lending and market debt. We develop a quantitative sovereign default model featuring a large senior lender with whom borrowing terms are negotiated. Obtaining more net financing from the market strengthens the government’s bargaining position and improves bilateral terms. This endogenous cross-elasticity erodes the discipline of spreads and amplifies debt dilution, leading to welfare losses even as bilateral borrowing helps avert some defaults ex-post. With pre-specified rules, rewarding market issuance can be enough to generate such losses, and an optimal rule instead raises bilateral rates with net market financing. The direction of the cross-elasticity can thus guide in practice the assessment of new forms of bilateral sovereign debt.
abstract_zh: 受巴黎俱乐部框架之外新兴官方债权人出现的启发，我们研究了高级官方贷款与市场债务之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个定量主权违约模型，其中包含一个大型高级贷款人，其借款条款通过谈判确定。从市场获得更多净融资增强了政府的谈判地位，并改善了双边条款。这种内生交叉弹性削弱了利差的纪律性，并加剧了债务稀释，即使双边借款在事后有助于避免一些违约，也会导致福利损失。在预设规则下，奖励市场发行可能足以产生此类损失，而最优规则反而会随着市场净融资增加而提高双边利率。因此，交叉弹性的方向在实践中可指导对新形式双边主权债务的评估。

title: Do non-binding trade promotion partnerships create trade? Evidence from UK-US state memoranda of understanding
title_zh: 非约束性贸易促进伙伴关系能否创造贸易？来自英美州级谅解备忘录的证据
title_primary: 非约束性贸易促进伙伴关系能否创造贸易？来自英美州级谅解备忘录的证据
title_secondary: Do non-binding trade promotion partnerships create trade? Evidence from UK-US state memoranda of understanding
authors: Michael Nower
official: 官方在线 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Governments increasingly use soft, non-binding trade promotion partnerships alongside, or instead of, binding agreements, but their effects remain unclear. This paper studies the UK’s post-Brexit memoranda of understanding with individual US states. These partnerships promote trade and investment but cannot alter tariffs or establish enforceable market-access commitments. Using a structural gravity model and monthly state level goods trade data, we find no evidence of broad goods trade creation. Aggregate effects are insignificant, and product- and state-level estimates are heterogeneous rather than systematically positive, suggesting MoUs support economic cooperation rather than producing the broad trade effects associated with traditional binding agreements.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益倾向于在具有约束力的协议之外或取而代之，采用软性的、非约束性的贸易促进伙伴关系，但其效果仍不明确。本文研究了英国脱欧后与美国各州签署的谅解备忘录。这些伙伴关系旨在促进贸易与投资，但无法改变关税或确立可执行的市场准入承诺。利用结构引力模型和月度州级商品贸易数据，我们发现没有证据表明存在广泛的商品贸易创造效应。总体影响不显著，且产品和州层面的估计结果呈现异质性而非系统性正向，这表明谅解备忘录支持经济合作，而非产生与传统约束性协议相关的广泛贸易效应。

title: Financial disclosure under regulatory fragmentation
title_zh: 监管碎片化下的财务信息披露
title_primary: 监管碎片化下的财务信息披露
title_secondary: Financial disclosure under regulatory fragmentation
authors: J. Kalodimos
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Regulatory fragmentation occurs when multiple agencies promulgate overlapping rules on the same policy topic, requiring firms to coordinate compliance across regulators and reconcile potentially inconsistent requirements. While prior work documents the real economic effects of regulatory fragmentation, this paper examines how regulatory fragmentation is reflected in the disclosures firms produce. Across the numerical and textual content of 10-K and 10-Q filings, I find that regulatory fragmentation is associated with systematic differences in firms' disclosure characteristics. Firms in more fragmented regulatory environments produce less complex numerical disclosures, a pattern concentrated in the notes to the financial statements and in industries whose oversight is persistently fragmented. By contrast, the associations between regulatory fragmentation and narrative disclosure characteristics vary with agency exposure. Among firms exposed to few agencies, regulatory fragmentation is associated with fewer words and sentences, smaller filing size, and more readable text. Among firms exposed to many agencies, it is associated with more words and sentences, while its association with filing size is no longer distinguishable from zero.
abstract_zh: 监管碎片化是指多个机构就同一政策主题颁布重叠规则，要求企业在各监管者之间协调合规，并调和可能不一致的要求。既有研究记录了监管碎片化的实际经济效应，而本文则考察监管碎片化如何反映在企业所生成的披露中。通过对10-K和10-Q文件的数值与文本内容进行分析，我发现监管碎片化与企业披露特征的系统性差异相关联。处于更碎片化监管环境中的企业，其数值披露的复杂性较低，这一模式集中于财务报表附注以及监管持续碎片化的行业。相比之下，监管碎片化与叙述性披露特征之间的关联因机构暴露程度而异。在接触机构较少的企业中，监管碎片化与更少的词数和句数、更小的文件规模以及更易读的文本相关。在接触机构较多的企业中，监管碎片化与更多的词数和句数相关，而其与文件规模的关联则不再显著区别于零。

title: Foreign Exchange Trading During World Cup Events (or I will watch the game while you trade)
title_zh: 世界杯赛事期间的外汇交易（或：你看比赛我交易）
title_primary: 世界杯赛事期间的外汇交易（或：你看比赛我交易）
title_secondary: Foreign Exchange Trading During World Cup Events (or I will watch the game while you trade)
authors: Michael Melvin, Louisa Mergner, Mykola Ryzhenkov, Frank Westermann
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze foreign exchange (FX) trading on FIFA World Cup game days in comparison to “normal” days. The FX market is an interesting case to study, as it has an institutional feature that allows participants to shift their trading needs to a counterparty bank so that the bank executes the trades at the London 4 p.m. fix. This “trade‐shifting” allows the client to avoid actively managing their trades and spend more time on World Cup‐related events. Using data from two different sources (EBS and CLS), we document this behavior and find that the effects are statistically and economically significant.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了国际足联世界杯比赛日与“正常”日的外汇交易行为。外汇市场是值得研究的有趣案例，因其制度特征允许参与者将交易需求转移至对手方银行，由该银行在伦敦下午4点定盘价时执行交易。这种“交易转移”机制使客户无需主动管理交易，从而将更多时间投入世界杯相关活动。基于两个不同数据源（EBS和CLS）的实证分析，我们记录了这一行为，并发现其影响在统计和经济意义上均具有显著性。

title: Is the Bond Market Competitive? Evidence from the ECB's Asset Purchase Program
title_zh: 债券市场是竞争性的吗？来自欧洲央行资产购买计划的证据

authors: J. Breckenfelder, Pierre Collin-Dufresne, Stefano Corradin
official: 官方在线 2024-10-12 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show that during the period of the Public Sector Purchase Program (PSPP) implemented by the Eurosystem, the prices of German sovereign bonds targeted by the PSPP increase predictably towards month-end and drop subsequently. We propose a sequential search-bargaining model that captures salient features of the implementation of the PSPP such as the commitment to buy within an explicit time horizon. The model can explain the predictable pattern as a result of imperfect competition between dealers that are counterparties to the Eurosystem. Motivated by the model’s predictions, we show that the price pattern is more pronounced (a) for bonds that are targeted by the PSPP, (b) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem has fewer counterparties, and (c) for monthly windows where the Eurosystem targets a larger amount of purchases. We discuss the implications of our analysis for future purchase programs. *We thank ECB and Bundesbank market operations and risk management colleagues and seminar participants at the European Central Bank for helpful comments. The views expressed are those of the authors and do not necessarily reflect those of the Eurosystem.

abstract: We study how politically polarized television news shapes household inflation expectations in Turkey. We combine new household panel data with transcript-based measures of channel-level inflation coverage during prime-time news and a large-scale randomized information experiment. Inflation coverage differs sharply across politically aligned channels, and viewers sort into outlets consistent with their political affiliations. Within-person estimates show that greater coverage on a respondent’s initially preferred channel leads to higher inflation expectations, with effects concentrated among viewers of politically neutral channels. Experimental evidence indicates that belief updating depends on prior anchoring as well as on source credibility and reveals the political costs of rising inflation expectations.

abstract: Assessing the real-world economic value of weather forecasts remains challenging, particularly in the context of high-impact extreme events. Although meteorological skill has improved substantially in recent years—driven by steady advances in physics-based models and impressive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence-based forecasting—operational evaluations still focus primarily on standard skill metrics, with limited consideration of how improvements in meteorological skill translate into economic value. This study proposes a flexible framework to assess the economic value of weather forecasts, with penalty functions that explicitly account for compounding losses as well as declining user trust in cases of repeated false alarms. In addition, the framework allows for varying cost—loss ratios to represent heterogeneous prevention costs and vulnerability structures. The framework is applied to cities exposed to weather-related natural hazards, comparing the relative economic value of leading physics-based and data-driven forecasting systems from the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts. The value of forecasts is highly sensitive to assumptions about compounding losses, penalty structures, and prevention costs, which often substantially alter conclusions drawn from meteorological skill alone. For instance, in some cities in Southern Europe, the higher sensitivity of the physics-based Integrated Forecast System high-resolution model (IFS HRES) makes it better suited when protection costs are small relative to potential losses, while the higher specificity of the data-driven Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) makes it better when protection costs are higher. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating economic value under realistic risk scenarios to ensure that improvements in predictive accuracy translate into meaningful societal and economic benefits.
abstract_zh: 评估天气预报的真实经济价值仍具挑战性，尤其是在高影响极端事件的背景下。尽管近年来气象预报技能显著提升——得益于基于物理模型的稳步改进和基于人工智能预报的突破性进展——但业务评估仍主要聚焦于标准技能指标，对气象技能提升如何转化为经济价值的考量十分有限。本研究提出一个灵活框架来评估天气预报的经济价值，其惩罚函数明确考虑了复合损失以及重复误报情况下用户信任度下降的影响。此外，该框架允许成本-损失比变化，以表征异质性预防成本和脆弱性结构。将该框架应用于面临天气相关自然灾害的城市，比较了欧洲中期天气预报中心领先的基于物理模型和数据驱动预报系统的相对经济价值。预报价值对复合损失、惩罚结构和预防成本的假设高度敏感，这些因素往往显著改变仅基于气象技能得出的结论。例如，在南欧部分城市，当保护成本相对于潜在损失较小时，基于物理模型的综合预报系统高分辨率模式（IFS HRES）因其更高灵敏度而更适用；而当保护成本较高时，数据驱动的人工智能预报系统（AIFS）因其更高特异性而表现更优。这些发现强调了在现实风险情景下评估经济价值的重要性，以确保预报精度的提升转化为有意义的社会经济效益。

title: Large-scale land acquisitions in Ethiopia: Impacts on agricultural productivity and deforestation
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚大规模土地收购：对农业生产率与森林砍伐的影响

authors: Workineh Asmare Kassie, Yeshwas Admasu, Dagim Belay, Solomon Zena Walelign, Jipeng Zhang

abstract: Large-scale land acquisitions (LSLAs) have expanded rapidly in developing countries and promoted as a pathway to accelerate agricultural transformation. Yet, credible evidence on their developmental and environmental impacts remains limited. This paper provides causal evidence on the effects of LSLAs on agricultural production and forest outcomes by exploiting spatial and temporal variation in the staggered implementation of LSLAs in Gambella, Ethiopia. We combine geo-referenced administrative records on land transactions (2000–2020) with high-resolution remote sensing data on crop production, forest cover, and land use. Using a heterogeneity robust difference-in-difference estimator, we find no evidence that LSLAs increase agricultural production or the share of crop land. In contrast, it leads to significant and persistent declines in tree cover and forest land share. This deforestation-production paradox suggests that, in settings characterized by weak oversight and insufficient infrastructure, poorly regulated large-scale investments can generate substantial environmental burden without delivering the anticipated structural transformation that justifies them.
abstract_zh: 大规模土地收购（LSLAs）在发展中国家迅速扩张，并被推崇为加速农业转型的途径。然而，关于其发展与环境影响的可靠证据仍然有限。本文利用埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区大规模土地收购分阶段实施中的时空变异，提供了LSLAs对农业生产和森林结果影响的因果证据。我们将2000至2020年间地理编码的土地交易行政记录与高分辨率遥感数据（涵盖作物生产、森林覆盖和土地利用）相结合。采用异质性稳健的双重差分估计方法，我们发现没有证据表明LSLAs增加了农业生产或耕地占比。相反，它导致了树木覆盖率和林地占比的显著且持续下降。这种毁林-生产悖论表明，在监管薄弱和基础设施不足的环境中，监管不力的大规模投资可能产生巨大的环境负担，而未能实现预期的结构性转型，从而无法证明其合理性。

abstract: Studies about climate change effects on service industries in developing countries are limited. Using data from daily flights among 211 Chinese airports (2015–2017), this paper investigates the causal impacts of extreme temperatures on aviation service quality, measured by flight delays. We find that extreme low temperatures significantly increase flight delays, with additional exposure causing longer departure delays, arrival delays, and excessive travel time. Conversely, extreme high temperatures have limited effects or even improve punctuality. This discrepancy arises primarily from differing meteorological disruptions and distinct market-driven airline operational adjustments in response to cold versus hot weather conditions. Low temperatures ( 20 °C) yields average monetary gains equivalent to about 0.04% of local GDP.
abstract_zh: 关于气候变化对发展中国家服务业影响的研究较为有限。本文利用2015至2017年间中国211个机场的每日航班数据，探讨极端温度对航空服务质量（以航班延误衡量）的因果影响。研究发现，极端低温显著增加航班延误，额外暴露于低温会导致离港延误、到港延误及超时旅行时间延长。相反，极端高温的影响有限，甚至可能提升准点率。这一差异主要源于不同的气象干扰以及航空公司针对冷热天气条件采取的不同市场驱动运营调整。低温（20°C）带来的平均货币收益相当于当地GDP的约0.04%。

title: Does ESG performance drive enterprise green technological innovation? Evidence from China
title_zh: ESG表现是否驱动企业绿色技术创新？来自中国的证据

authors: Hang Chen, Xiaotian Zhu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Amid the imperative for global climate governance and sustainable development, green technological innovation is a vital path for firms to overcome resource constraints and improve development quality. By bridging firms and capital markets, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings improve the external information environment and establish a market-based governance framework aligned with green innovation incentives. Leveraging SynTao Green Finance’s inaugural publication of ESG ratings as a quasi-natural experiment, this article examines the effect of these ratings on green technological innovation, using a time-varying difference-in-differences approach on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2021. We find that favourable ESG performance significantly promotes green technological innovation, a result confirmed by extensive robustness checks. Three transmission channels are identified: alleviating financing constraints, raising innovation efficiency, and amplifying market attention. The promotional effect is particularly salient in growth-stage, eastern-region, high-tech, and highly competitive firms. Further analysis shows that ESG ratings strengthen the intertemporal continuity of corporate green innovation and that CEOs’ green professional background positively moderates this relationship. Regulators should accelerate the standardization of China’s ESG disclosure framework and broaden its coverage. Firms should strengthen internal controls and non-financial reporting so that improved ESG performance translates into substantive green innovation.
abstract_zh: 在全球气候治理与可持续发展的紧迫要求下，绿色技术创新成为企业突破资源约束、提升发展质量的关键路径。环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级通过连接企业与资本市场，改善了外部信息环境，并构建了与绿色创新激励相容的市场化治理机制。本文以商道融绿首次发布ESG评级作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法，基于2009—2021年中国A股上市公司数据，考察ESG评级对绿色技术创新的影响。研究发现，良好的ESG表现显著促进了企业绿色技术创新，该结论经过一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明，缓解融资约束、提升创新效率以及增强市场关注是三条传导渠道。异质性分析显示，这一促进效应在成长期企业、东部地区企业、高技术企业以及高竞争行业企业中更为显著。进一步分析表明，ESG评级增强了企业绿色创新的跨期连续性，且CEO的绿色职业背景对这一关系具有正向调节作用。监管机构应加快中国ESG披露框架的标准化进程并扩大覆盖范围；企业应强化内部控制与非财务信息披露，使ESG表现的改善切实转化为实质性绿色创新。

title: Horizontal and Vertical Connector Countries in a Geoeconomically Fragmenting World

authors: Shekhar Aiyar, Franziska Ohnsorge, Hakan Yilmazkuday
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Geoeconomic fragmentation—the phenomenon of international transactions being increasingly restricted to politically aligned partners-creates risks for individual countries but also opportunities that some hope to seize by becoming "connector" countries. We modify a standard trade model by introducing iceberg costs that increase with geopolitical distance between country pairs. The response of per capita consumption to a geopolitical shock is shown to depend on two related but distinct indices: vulnerability, which is a country's transaction-weighted geopolitical distance from its trade partners, and connectedness, which is a country's transaction-weighted standard deviation of geopolitical distance from trade partners. The latter captures a country's geopolitical diversification. We distinguish between this type of "horizontal" connectedness and the supply chain-related "vertical" connectedness discussed by previous authors, arguing that the horizontal measure is more relevant in a geoeconomically fragmenting world. We construct a comprehensive database to examine geoeconomic vulnerability and connectedness across multiple types of international transactions, documenting several stylized facts.
abstract_zh: 地缘经济碎片化——即国际交易日益局限于政治立场一致的伙伴之间的现象——既给各国带来风险，也带来机遇，一些国家希望通过成为"连接国"来抓住这些机遇。我们通过引入随国家间地缘政治距离增加而上升的冰山成本，对标准贸易模型进行了修正。研究表明，人均消费对地缘政治冲击的反应取决于两个相关但不同的指标：脆弱性，即一国与其贸易伙伴之间按交易量加权的地缘政治距离；以及连接度，即一国与其贸易伙伴之间按交易量加权的地缘政治距离标准差。后者反映了一国的地缘政治多元化程度。我们将这种"横向"连接度与先前学者讨论的供应链相关"纵向"连接度加以区分，认为在地缘经济碎片化加剧的世界中，横向指标更具相关性。我们构建了一个综合数据库，考察多种国际交易类型中的地缘经济脆弱性与连接度，并归纳出若干典型化事实。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how labor market power affects the transmission of monetary policy. Using administrative U.S. Census data, we show that firms with high monopsony power—defined as those accounting for over 10 percent of the local wage bill—respond less to monetary policy in terms of their wage bill and employment. We then develop a New Keynesian model with heterogeneous firms and oligopsonistic competition to interpret these findings. Wage stickiness combined with firms’ labor market power is key to generating the heterogeneous responses that we document. Our model highlights two channels through which oligopsony shapes the aggregate effects of monetary policy: partial passthrough and misallocation. Calibrated to U.S. labor markets, the model implies that the decline in labor market power since the 1980s has increased the output response to monetary policy by about 10 percent and accounts for about 15 percent of the estimated flattening of the Phillips curve.
abstract_zh: 本文研究劳动力市场势力如何影响货币政策的传导机制。基于美国人口普查局的行政数据，我们发现，具有高垄断势力（定义为占当地工资总额10%以上）的企业，其工资总额和就业对货币政策的反应较弱。为解释这一发现，我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和寡头竞争的新凯恩斯模型。工资粘性与企业劳动力市场势力的结合，是产生我们所记录的异质性反应的关键。该模型揭示了寡头垄断影响货币政策总体效应的两个渠道：部分传导效应与资源错配效应。基于美国劳动力市场的校准结果表明，自20世纪80年代以来劳动力市场势力的下降，使货币政策对产出的影响增强了约10%，并解释了菲利普斯曲线估计平坦化现象的约15%。

title: Does Pollution Prevention Enhance Firm Efficiency? Insights from U.S. Manufacturing Firms

abstract: Pollution prevention is the EPA’s highest-priority approach to managing toxic chemicals, yet its effects on firm efficiency remain largely unexplored. We address this using a by-production stochastic frontier framework that models desirable output and emissions as linked but distinct production processes, allowing us to separately identify technical and environmental efficiency. The model is estimated across three broad U.S. manufacturing industries (NAICS 31, 32, and 33), using a panel of Compustat, TRI, and EPA P2 data over 1991–2016. Under maintained timing assumptions, we find that a 10% increase in cumulative source reduction improves technical efficiency by 0.09%–0.17% across industries, corresponding to $5.5–$11.2 million in additional real sales at the respective industry means. Source reduction also reduces environmental inefficiency in NAICS 32 and NAICS 33, implying reductions of 4,435–5,802 pounds of toxic releases at the industry means; the effect is not significant in NAICS 31. A disaggregated analysis reveals that different source-reduction activities operate through distinct channels, with material substitution as the most consistent driver of gains in both technical and environmental efficiency.
abstract_zh: 污染防治是美国环保署管理有毒化学品的最优先方法，然而其对厂商效率的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。我们通过一个副产品生产随机前沿框架来解决这一问题，该框架将期望产出与排放建模为相互关联但不同的生产过程，从而能够分别识别技术效率和环境效率。该模型基于1991年至2016年间Compustat、TRI和EPA P2数据的面板数据，在美国三大制造业（NAICS 31、32和33）中进行估计。在保持时间假设的前提下，我们发现累计源头削减增加10%可使各行业的技术效率提高0.09%至0.17%，对应各行业均值下额外实际销售额为550万至1120万美元。源头削减还降低了NAICS 32和NAICS 33中的环境无效率，意味着行业均值下有毒排放减少4，435至5，802磅；而在NAICS 31中该效应不显著。一项分解分析显示，不同的源头削减活动通过不同渠道发挥作用，其中材料替代是技术效率和环境效率提升最一致的驱动因素。

title: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
title_zh: 企业吸收外部知识能力的测度
title_primary: 企业吸收外部知识能力的测度
title_secondary: Measuring firms’ capability to absorb external knowledge
authors: Michael Woeppel, M. Deniz Yavuz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As the economy has become increasingly knowledge-based, firms’ capability to benefit from external knowledge has grown in importance. We construct a measure of this capability – absorption intensity – from information in firms’ patents. To validate the measure, we exploit the American Inventors Protection Act (AIPA), which exogenously increased patent information availability. A triple-difference design shows that firms with higher absorption intensity experience greater innovation growth when more exposed to the reform. Beyond AIPA, absorption intensity predicts stronger innovation outcomes and firm growth. Our measure offers a tool to study how differences in absorption capability shape returns to external knowledge.
abstract_zh: 随着经济日益向知识密集型转型，企业从外部知识中获益的能力愈发重要。我们基于企业专利信息构建了一项衡量该能力的指标——吸收强度。为验证这一指标的有效性，我们利用了《美国发明人保护法案》（AIPA），该法案外生地增加了专利信息的可获得性。三重差分设计显示，在改革影响更显著的条件下，吸收强度较高的企业实现了更大的创新增长。除AIPA情境外，吸收强度还能预测更优的创新成果和企业成长。我们的指标为研究吸收能力差异如何影响外部知识回报提供了工具。

title: Econobiomes: A terrestrial-based country classification for international sustainability comparison
title_zh: 生态生物群落：基于陆地的国家分类用于国际可持续性比较
title_primary: 生态生物群落：基于陆地的国家分类用于国际可持续性比较
title_secondary: Econobiomes: A terrestrial-based country classification for international sustainability comparison
authors: Trichet Matthieu, Maurin Julie, Calas Julien
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Biodiversity loss, driven by human activities such as land-use change, climate change, and pollution, is a critical global challenge. Effective sustainability performance assessments, especially at the national level, require tools that account for biophysical characteristics alongside economic and social factors. Current methods often overlook the ecological constraints and opportunities shaped by biomes—large-scale regions defined by climatic and ecological attributes that influence ecosystem services. This study introduces Econobiome classifications, a novel country categorization system based on terrestrial ecosystem composition and the spatial distribution of economic activities, including agriculture, forestry, and night light data. Using partitioning clustering techniques, we classify countries into four distinct groupings: cropland (11 clusters), forestry (5 clusters), night light (7 clusters), and all activities (7 clusters). The classifications highlight how dominant biomes and economic activity locations shape ecological conditions and sustainability constraints. We apply the Econobiome framework to benchmark the environmental efficiency of national agricultural systems (NAS) using data envelopment analysis (DEA). Results reveal significant variation in eco-efficiency across clusters, underscoring the importance of context-sensitive comparisons in sustainability diagnostics. While the Econobiome framework improves ecological comparability across countries, it relies on national-scale data and does not capture subnational ecological and socio-economic variation. Yet, the Econobiome classification provides policymakers and researchers with a robust tool to align environmental assessments with ecological realities, improving the accuracy of sustainability benchmarks and supporting evidence-based decision-making in the face of the biodiversity crisis.
abstract_zh: 生物多样性丧失，由土地利用变化、气候变化和污染等人类活动驱动，是全球面临的严峻挑战。有效的可持续性绩效评估，尤其是在国家层面，需要能够兼顾生物物理特征与经济和社会因素的工具。当前方法往往忽视了由生物群落——即由影响生态系统服务的气候和生态属性定义的大规模区域——所塑造的生态约束与机遇。本研究引入了Econobiome分类法，这是一种基于陆地生态系统组成及经济活动空间分布（包括农业、林业和夜间灯光数据）的新型国家分类体系。利用分区聚类技术，我们将国家划分为四个不同的组别：农田（11个聚类）、林业（5个聚类）、夜间灯光（7个聚类）及所有活动（7个聚类）。这些分类突显了主导生物群落和经济活动位置如何塑造生态条件和可持续性约束。我们应用Econobiome框架，通过数据包络分析（DEA）对国家农业系统（NAS）的环境效率进行基准评估。结果显示各聚类间生态效率存在显著差异，强调了在可持续性诊断中考虑情境敏感性比较的重要性。尽管Econobiome框架提高了国家间的生态可比性，但它依赖于国家尺度数据，未能捕捉次国家层面的生态和社会经济变异。然而，Econobiome分类为政策制定者和研究人员提供了一个强有力的工具，使环境评估与生态现实相契合，提高了可持续性基准的准确性，并在生物多样性危机面前支持基于证据的决策。

title: Contract Labour, Job Quality and Turnover Intention—Evidence From Nigeria
title_zh: 合同工、工作质量与离职意向——来自尼日利亚的证据
title_primary: 合同工、工作质量与离职意向——来自尼日利亚的证据
title_secondary: Contract Labour, Job Quality and Turnover Intention—Evidence From Nigeria
authors: Olayinka Aremu, Patrick Illien, Adeola Oluwafunmiso Olajide, Eva‐Marie Meemken
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Labour contracting, where intermediaries provide farmers with migrant workers, plays a central role in meeting the demand for seasonal labour on labour‐intensive farms. Yet this system poses underresearched challenges for both workers and farmers. A few studies, mostly qualitative, link labour contracting to exploitative conditions, raising concerns about workers' welfare (Sustainable Development Goal 8). However, poor working conditions are widespread in agriculture, and notably, quantitative comparisons between contract and non‐contract workers are lacking. For farmers, these precarious conditions pose a production risk if they lead to higher turnover. However, such links have so far been mainly documented in high‐skilled settings. Here, we address these gaps and provide the first empirical evidence on the links between contract labour, job quality and turnover intention. We use matched worker–employer survey data, rarely available in agricultural research, complemented with qualitative insights from a well‐suited case study: Nigeria's labour‐intensive tomato sector, where farmers recruit workers through personal networks and labour contractors. Using decomposition analysis—commonly used to examine gender gaps—in a novel way, we assess disparities in working conditions between contract and non‐contract workers. Our findings show that contract labour is associated with structural disparities in working conditions. Complementary qualitative insights show how rules, norms and practices embedded in labour contracting systems contribute to these structural inequalities. Paradoxically, despite poorer conditions, contract workers report job satisfaction levels similar to non‐contract workers—likely reflecting limited alternatives. Consequently, turnover intentions are comparable across both groups, with job satisfaction being the primary driver of turnover intentions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 劳务承包，即中介机构为农民提供外来务工人员，在满足劳动密集型农场的季节性劳动力需求方面发挥着核心作用。然而，这一体系对工人和农民双方均构成了研究不足的挑战。少数研究，多为定性研究，将劳务承包与剥削性劳动条件联系起来，引发了对工人福利（可持续发展目标8）的担忧。然而，农业领域恶劣的工作条件普遍存在，且值得注意的是，缺乏对合同工与非合同工之间的定量比较。对农民而言，这些不稳定的条件若导致更高的员工流动率，则构成生产风险。然而，此类关联迄今主要在高技能环境中得到记录。在此，我们填补这些空白，首次提供关于合同劳动、工作质量与离职意向之间关联的实证证据。我们使用农业研究中罕见的匹配工人-雇主调查数据，并辅以来自一个适宜案例研究的定性见解：尼日利亚劳动密集型番茄产业，该产业中农民通过个人网络和劳务承包商招募工人。我们创新性地运用分解分析——通常用于考察性别差距——来评估合同工与非合同工之间工作条件的差异。我们的研究结果表明，合同劳动与工作条件的结构性差异相关联。补充的定性见解揭示了劳务承包体系中嵌入的规则、规范和实践如何促成这些结构性不平等。矛盾的是，尽管条件较差，合同工报告的工作满意度与非合同工相似——这可能反映了有限的选择。因此，两组人员的离职意向相当，工作满意度是离职意向的主要驱动因素。

title: The Impact of Credit and Training on Farmers Efficiency: A Semi‐Parametric Meta‐Frontier Analysis
title_zh: 信贷与培训对农户效率的影响：基于半参数元前沿分析
title_primary: 信贷与培训对农户效率的影响：基于半参数元前沿分析
title_secondary: The Impact of Credit and Training on Farmers Efficiency: A Semi‐Parametric Meta‐Frontier Analysis
authors: Anthony Baffoe‐Bonnie, Genti Kostandini
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Smallholder farmers in developing countries face several constraints, which affect their productivity. To reduce these constraints and enhance productivity, government and non‐governmental agencies implement programmes that provide credit and training to farmers. In this study, we evaluate the impact of one of such programme on the efficiency of farmers. Specifically, we evaluate the impact of providing both credit and training on the efficiency of peanut farmers in Haiti. To achieve this goal, first, we use the Propensity Score Matching (PSM) technique to balance our dataset, thereby accounting for selection bias based on observable factors. Second, we correct for selection bias from non‐observable factors by using the Selectivity‐bias Correction Stochastic Production Frontier (SC‐SPF) to estimate the efficiency scores on the balanced sample. Third, given that there might be differences in the technology used by farmers, we estimate a meta‐frontier to compare the efficiency scores while addressing the incorrect skewness problem in frontier analysis. Our results show that farmers who received both credit and training had higher efficiency scores, suggesting that interventions that increase credit access and transfer knowledge can enhance productivity and help to address food security issues.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家的农户面临多重制约因素，这些因素影响了他们的生产力。为缓解这些制约并提升生产力，政府及非政府机构实施了向农户提供信贷和培训的项目。本研究评估了此类项目之一对农户效率的影响。具体而言，我们评估了同时提供信贷和培训对海地花生农户效率的影响。为实现此目标，首先，我们采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）技术平衡数据集，从而基于可观测因素控制选择偏差。其次，我们通过使用选择性偏差校正随机生产前沿（SC-SPF）模型，在平衡样本上估计效率得分，以校正来自不可观测因素的选择偏差。第三，鉴于农户可能采用的技术存在差异，我们估计了一个元前沿，以比较效率得分，同时解决前沿分析中的错误偏斜问题。我们的结果显示，同时接受信贷和培训的农户具有更高的效率得分，这表明增加信贷获取和知识转移的干预措施能够提升生产力，并有助于解决粮食安全问题。

title: Strategyproof randomized social choice for restricted sets of utility functions
title_zh: 受限效用函数集合上的防策略随机社会选择
title_primary: 受限效用函数集合上的防策略随机社会选择
title_secondary: Strategyproof randomized social choice for restricted sets of utility functions
authors: Patrick Lederer
official: 官方在线 2026-04-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Social decision schemes (SDSs) map the voters’ preferences over multiple alternatives to a probability distribution over these alternatives. In a seminal result, Gibbard (Econometrica 45(3):665–681, 1977) has characterized the set of SDSs that are strategyproof with respect to all utility functions and his result implies that all such SDSs are either unfair to the voters or alternatives, or they require a significant amount of randomization. To circumvent this negative result, we propose the notion of U -strategyproofness which postulates that only voters with a utility function in a predefined set U cannot manipulate. We then analyze the tradeoff between U -strategyproofness and various decisiveness notions that restrict the amount of randomization of SDSs. In particular, we show that if the utility functions in the set U value the best alternative much more than other alternatives, there are U -strategyproof SDSs that choose an alternative with probability 1 whenever all but k voters rank it first. On the negative side, we demonstrate that U -strategyproofness is incompatible with Condorcet-consistency if the set U satisfies minimal symmetry conditions. Finally, we show that no ex post efficient and U -strategyproof SDS can be significantly more decisive than the uniform random dictatorship if the voters are close to indifferent between their two favorite alternatives. abstract_zh: 社会决策方案（SDSs）将选民对多个备选方案的偏好映射为这些备选方案上的概率分布。在开创性成果中，Gibbard（Econometrica 45(3):665–681, 1977）刻画了所有效用函数下均满足策略防护性的SDS集合，其结论表明此类SDS要么对选民或备选方案不公，要么需要大量随机化。为规避这一负面结论，我们提出U-策略防护性概念，该概念仅要求具有预设集合U中效用函数的选民无法操纵。进而分析U-策略防护性与限制SDS随机化程度的各种决定性概念之间的权衡关系。特别地，我们证明：若集合U中的效用函数对最优备选方案的估值远高于其他方案，则存在U-策略防护性SDS，当除k名选民外的所有选民均将某方案列为首选时，该方案以概率1被选中。在负面结论方面，我们证明当集合U满足最小对称性条件时，U-策略防护性与孔多塞一致性不可兼容。最后，我们证明若选民对其最偏好的两个备选方案近乎无差异，则不存在比均匀随机独裁更具显著决定性的事后有效且U-策略防护性SDS。

title: Success and failure in England's patent system: New evidence from patent applications, 1783–1834
title_zh: 英国专利制度的成功与失败：来自1783–1834年专利申请的新证据
title_primary: 英国专利制度的成功与失败：来自1783–1834年专利申请的新证据
title_secondary: Success and failure in England's patent system: New evidence from patent applications, 1783–1834
authors: Stephen D. Billington, Joe Lane
official: 官方在线 2026-03-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Our understanding of the relationship between the English patent system and technical change during the industrial revolution is based entirely on the study of successful patents. We address this feature by providing the first study of unsuccessful patent applications in England during the first industrial revolution. The paper presents a new hand‐collected dataset of 722 unsuccessful patent applications filed in England between 1783 and 1834, drawn from archival records of the Home Office. Combined with existing records of granted patents, we employ econometric analysis to empirically investigate the determinants of patent failure. Using natural language processing techniques to measure patent novelty, we find that more novel patents and patents originating from technological outsiders were more likely to fail. We also find early failure discouraged applicants from subsequent patenting attempts, although we find no evidence that failed applications were of a lower economic value than successful ones. Our findings are linked to a system of ex ante private opposition of patents, known as caveat opposition, specific to the English patent system at the time. We argue the caveat system served to block threatening competitors rather than filter out low‐quality patents. Private opposition, therefore, likely impeded knowledge diffusion during Britain's industrial revolution.
abstract_zh: 我们对工业革命期间英国专利制度与技术变革之间关系的理解，完全基于对成功专利的研究。我们通过首次对第一次工业革命期间英国未成功专利申请的研究来弥补这一空白。本文基于内政部的档案记录，提供了一个新手工收集的数据集，包含1783年至1834年间在英格兰提交的722项未成功专利申请。结合现有的授权专利记录，我们运用计量经济学分析，实证探究专利失败的 determinants。利用自然语言处理技术衡量专利新颖性，我们发现更新颖的专利和来自技术领域外部人士的专利更可能失败。我们还发现，早期失败抑制了申请人后续的专利申请尝试，尽管我们没有发现失败申请的经济价值低于成功申请的证据。我们的发现与当时英国专利制度特有的“预先私人异议”系统（即“警告异议”）相关联。我们认为，这一警告系统旨在阻止威胁性竞争者，而非筛选低质量专利。因此，私人异议很可能阻碍了英国工业革命期间的知识传播。

abstract: Abstract From a sample of the most prominent Greek city‐states, data involving a total of 999 hoards and 160,007 coins from 550 to 300 BC were collected to discern the relative magnitudes, consistency of issue, and distribution of Classical Greek coinages. Of the city‐states in this sample, the data display the widespread international use of several Classical Greek coinages. Most notable amongst these are the proliferation of Corinthian‐style coinage in Sicily and Italy and the penetration of Athenian coinage into non‐Greek areas such as the Levant and Egypt. The international movement of coins bolsters other forms of evidence for trade between Mediterranean civilizations in antiquity. Foreign imitations of the most successful internationally circulating coinages are also quantified and discussed.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本研究基于最著名的希腊城邦样本，收集了公元前550年至300年间共计999个窖藏和160,007枚硬币的数据，以探究古典希腊铸币的相对规模、发行一致性及其分布情况。样本中的城邦数据显示，几种古典希腊铸币在国际上广泛流通。其中最为显著的是科林斯式铸币在西西里和意大利的广泛传播，以及雅典铸币渗透至黎凡特和埃及等非希腊地区。硬币的国际流动为古代地中海文明间的贸易提供了其他形式的佐证。此外，本文还对最成功的国际流通铸币的外国仿制品进行了量化分析并加以讨论。

abstract: Transparency of government information plays an important role in impacting firms’ operations. Higher transparency can reduce political and economic uncertainty and improve the overall information environment, thereby reducing the negative impact on firms’ investment decisions. Using municipal level fiscal transparency, we find a significant positive relationship between local government fiscal transparency and enterprise digital transformation. Specifically, an increase of one standard deviation in fiscal transparency leads to a 2.04% improvement in the level of enterprise digital transformation. This effect remains significant in a series of robustness checks. Further analysis suggests that fiscal transparency significantly reduces the cost of debt, decreases uncertainty as estimated from analysts’ textual reports, and promotes more efficient resource allocation, thereby supporting the view that higher fiscal transparency facilitates digital transformation. Overall, this paper highlights the critical role of government behaviour at the micro level.
abstract_zh: 政府信息透明度在影响企业运营方面发挥着重要作用。更高的透明度能够降低政治与经济不确定性，改善整体信息环境，从而减轻对企业投资决策的负面影响。利用市级财政透明度数据，我们发现地方政府财政透明度与企业数字化转型之间存在显著的正相关关系。具体而言，财政透明度每增加一个标准差，企业数字化转型水平将提升2.04%。这一效应在一系列稳健性检验中依然显著。进一步分析表明，财政透明度显著降低了债务成本，减少了基于分析师文本报告所估计的不确定性，并促进了更高效的资源配置，从而支持了更高透明度有利于数字化转型的观点。总体而言，本文强调了政府行为在微观层面的关键作用。

abstract: This study focuses on the food and housing expenditures of households relative to their disposable incomes, utilizing a unique opportunity of merged national-level data from the Household Budget Survey and EU-Statistics on Income and Living Conditions in Czechia (2020–2023). The study considers both Engel’s law on food expenditures and Schwabe’s law on housing expenditures by verifying their implications for poverty measures. Interpretation of the two laws assumes that households spending the same shares of their income on food/housing are equally well-off, and a specific level of food-/housing-income ratio is then used as a poverty threshold, which implies that absolute household income is irrelevant to their economic well-being. Both laws are valid in Czechia: relative food and housing expenditures are decreasing with income. We proxy households’ economic well-being using both subjective and objective indicators of household economic well-being: within sub-groups with similar relative food/housing expenditures, absolute income still significantly affects the economic well-being of households. This effect is stronger for those designated as the poorest than it is for those deemed richest. We claim that the validity of Engel’s and Schwabe’s laws does not straightforwardly imply that having the same relative food/housing expenditures means that households are equally well-off.
